rules: Code every material object supported by the supplied source; one-object-per-paper shortcuts are prohibited.
Coders provide semantic fields and source locators but never object agreement keys; the compiler derives source anchors and segmentation signatures.
A changed dataset revision/split, model/access, input condition, intervention, or budget creates a new run cell; multiple metrics remain observations of one run.
An empirical extractable paper requires material run cells, observations and dataset nodes.
A paired comparison is required when baseline, intervention and comparability close; otherwise select the typed absence reason.
A source-backed dataset lineage or relation creates an edge; semantic similarity alone is not lineage.
REFERENCE transfers neither protocol nor result; BORROW_PROTOCOL requires explicit translation and rejection evidence.
Paper-visible reproduction support may be OPEN_WITH_BLOCKERS. REPRODUCTION_CANDIDATE requires CLOSED_PAPER_SUPPORT; local anchor readiness is reviewer-only.
Use precise page/section/table/row locators for objects; title-only or abstract-only locators do not support empirical objects.
Specialized Duplex systems and trained controllers cannot produce direct Agentic cells, reproduction anchors or branch primaries.

paper_disposition.when: claims or boundaries exist but no run is extractable
paper_disposition.counterexample: a paper with source-located tables of runs

paper_role.when: the intervention is the paper's evaluated method
paper_role.counterexample: a benchmark that only supplies an evaluator

paper_role.when: the work supplies measurement or evaluator contracts
paper_role.counterexample: a system intervention evaluated against baselines

reference_borrow_reproduce.when: no protocol or result is transferred
a decision structure is translated with a rejection observation
every paper-side fact is affirmatively OBSERVED_IN_SOURCE
reference_borrow_reproduce.counterexample: a non-observed revision, entrypoint, access, terms or evaluator fact

access_and_dependency.when: the foundation core is frozen and only input/output access is used
success depends on a specialized task core
access_and_dependency.counterexample: a generic frozen core calling external tools

agentic_scope.when: both decision and action/tool components are observable
agentic_scope.counterexample: a passive scorer with no action

agentic_scope.when: the work only measures or calibrates

primary_intervention.when: one manipulated asset/control explains the comparison
primary_intervention.counterexample: crediting every system component without ablation

loop_and_capability_assets.when: reusable procedural competence is supplied or routed
external facts or evidence are acquired

object_extraction_triggers.counterexample: a second metric from the same run

object_extraction_triggers.when: the source states dataset provenance or validation relation

object_extraction_triggers.counterexample: different model and budget with no controlled pair

compiler_owned_identity.source_anchor: rendition SHA256 + typed anchor + normalized coordinate
compiler_owned_identity.segmentation_signature: paper + object type + source anchors + typed identity tuple
